$comment: Where each testnet stand-in feed gets its price. mainnet-mirror: copied, price AND updatedAt, from the live Chainlink feed on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). public-quote: no Chainlink feed exists for this stock, so a free public quote is used, with the quote's own market timestamp. Addresses verified in docs/CHAIN_NOTES.md. ETFs (SPY, QQQ) mirror their own mainnet Chainlink feeds onto testnet stand-ins (a TestStockToken and a TestPriceFeed each: no ETF Stock Token exists on testnet); a source whose feed isn't deployed yet is simply not mirrored. Read by apps/keeper, apps/api and script/fetch-prices.sh.

NFLX.description: Yahoo Finance NFLX regularMarketPrice (no Chainlink NFLX feed exists on Robinhood Chain)
